description: Monroe County Single Family Residential Building Assets and Energy Consumption: 2017-2019 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. PLEASE DOWNLOAD THE FULL REPORT UNDER THE ATTACHMENT SECTION IN THE 'ABOUT THIS DATASET' SECTION BELOW. This aggregated and anonymized dataset of single-family residential building asset attributes and observed average annual energy consumption over the 2-year period from August 2017 through July 2019 is available for Monroe County. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Energy & Environment. Its tags are data analysis, building asset data, energy efficiency, monroe county, rge. The table has 16 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA). The portal shows 2021-04-27 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
